assets.prompt: A deep kaamos blue #1E3150 field with a very subtle smooth vertical gradient to deep fjord #0E1A2E at the bottom. In the centre, a large flat sun-yellow #F2C230 disc rising, about 46 percent of the icon width, its lower half hidden behind one bold bent plywood ribbon that sweeps in a single smooth asymmetric wave across the full width of the icon, slightly lower on the left and rising toward the right. The ribbon is birch white #F2EEE6 and reads as bent laminated plywood: its front face shows exactly three thick, evenly spaced parallel ply lines in frost #9DB9CC that follow the curve. A soft faint honey glow around the sun. Nothing else: no figure, no stars, no water, no text. Extremely bold and simple, readable at 29 pixels.
